parameters.query:
SELECT id, storage_key, received_at
FROM inbound_documents
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND attempts < 3
ORDER BY received_at
LIMIT 25;

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ Type: "ACCPAY", InvoiceNumber: $json.invoice.invoice_number, Date: $json.invoice.issue_date, DueDate: $json.invoice.due_date || null, CurrencyCode: $json.invoice.currency, Contact: { Name: $json.invoice.supplier_name }, LineItems: $json.invoice.line_items.map(li => ({ Description: li.description, Quantity: li.quantity, UnitAmount: li.unit_amount })) }) }}

parameters.query:
UPDATE inbound_documents
SET status = 'posted',
    extraction = $2::jsonb,
    processed_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;

UPDATE inbound_documents
SET status = 'needs_review',
    extraction = $2::jsonb,
    review_reasons = $3,
    attempts = attempts + 1,
    processed_at = now()
WHERE id = $1;

UPDATE inbound_documents
   SET attempts = attempts + 1,
       status = CASE WHEN attempts + 1 >= 3 THEN 'failed' ELSE 'pending' END,
       last_error = $2
 WHERE id = $1;
